expected: The F1 runner should start, record control-plane Ground Truth, complete injection and recovery, and return JSON before the integrated battery continues.
first_divergence: Python subprocess invocation of scripts.experiment.fault_smoke before its main function
root_cause: Direct file invocation sets the script directory as the import root, but fault_smoke.py imports scripts.experiment.ground_truth. Running python3 scripts/experiment/fault_smoke.py --help produced ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts' at line 17, before main or any fault action.
evidence: Read-only help invocation produced the ModuleNotFoundError stack trace.
Preserved BLOCKED-12-artifacts/F1 directory contains no ground-truth.json or fault report.
Post-failure Kubernetes query showed no StressChaos or NetworkChaos resources and the SUT was 11/11 Ready.
affected_invariant: Each fault in the frozen integrated run must complete and produce an auditable control-plane record before the run may continue.
scientific_impact: The integrated battery is invalid and yields no F1-F5 experimental result. The normal workload/RAW are preserved only as evidence from this failed attempt.
recommended_correction: Invoke the child as python -m scripts.experiment.fault_smoke from the repository root and include subprocess return code/stdout/stderr in JSON parse failures.
alternative: Set an explicit repository-root PYTHONPATH while invoking the script path; module invocation is simpler and matches the package import.
rerun_scope: A complete new F1-F5 battery on a new committed revision with rebuilt and redeployed images; do not retry only F1 or combine runs.
working_tree_at_failure: runner created blocker artifacts; no implementation edits occurred during the physical attempt
